{{Top|leg|title=''Miner'' group}}
'''''Miner''''' was a group of three [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports]] used by the [[Nami]]. During a [[battle of the Eva-T system]], the [[Transport/Legends|transports]] were used to deploy [[Space mine/Legends|space mines]] around the [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] ''[[Nuance]]'' in an attempt to defend it against an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. The transports and the mines were all destroyed during the battle, and the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was captured.
